card.name: Start of a unit word after a number
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that follows a number, such as min, decibels, mcg, or a section heading. It fires right after digits, when the word is only partly written.

modes.label: Units after numbers
modes.description: The opening piece of a measure like minutes, decibels, or micrograms right after a figure.
modes.example: 85<< dec>>ibels can be harmful your ears.)

modes.label: Section numbers before headings
modes.description: A number followed by the start of a capitalized heading or term.

card.plain: It lights up on the first part of a word that comes straight after a number, often a unit like decibels or mcg.
